statement:
Building shared datasets, software, and tools
should count as much as writing papers for
jobs and promotion.

Hiring and promotion committees should judge
scientists by reading a few of their best
papers, not by counting papers or citations.

If AI makes it easy to produce papers, the
number of papers someone publishes will stop
meaning anything.

Time a scientist spends following
curiosity, with no clear output, should
count as real work.

Scientists should write their papers so
that AI tools are more likely to find and
cite them.
